_about: Industry certifications and the founder's Anthropic Academy plan. Official URLs and prices were checked through the fetch lane (internal/docs-fetch, 2026-11-03): Google $99 and AWS 100 USD were on their own pages; GitHub and Microsoft price by country, so they say check the official page. price null means unverified. The site never shows these fees: price is kept for the record but unused, and only 0 (free) changes what a card says. show is the default; the founder overrides it at /admin/certifications. Nothing is marked done here: progress lives only in site settings, set by the founder.

items.name: GitHub Foundations
items.proves: You understand the GitHub basics: repositories, commits, branches, pull requests and collaborating on code.

items.name: GitHub Copilot
items.proves: You can use GitHub Copilot responsibly to write, explain, test and fix code.

items.name: Generative AI Leader
items.proves: You understand what generative AI can do for an organisation and how to adopt it well. It is a business-level certification, not a coding one.

prep.name: The official exam page, with its free learning path

items.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
items.proves: You know the core ideas of AI, machine learning and generative AI, and the AWS services that use them.

prep.name: The official exam page, with its exam guide

items.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals
items.proves: You know the fundamentals of AI workloads and the Azure AI services. AI-901 replaces AI-900, which is retired.

prep.name: AI-901 study guide and free Microsoft Learn paths

items.name: Claude Certified Architect, Foundations
items.proves: You can design solutions with Claude. Open only to organisations in the Claude Partner Network, so most individuals cannot sit it yet.
